name: De Los Altos Restaurant
notes: All 3 photos are clear shots of the same printed menu book (page 1: appetizers/Mexican mix, page 2: salads/soup/desserts/beverages, page 3: burgers/sandwiches); no duplicates, no food/storefront/receipt photos to skip.

dishes.name: Chips, Salsa & Guacamole
dishes.description: Crispy tortilla chips served with our fresh house-made red salsa and mild salsa. Topping it off with a side of fresh textured guacamole.

dishes.name: French Fries
dishes.description: Perfectly crispy golden fries, served with a side of ketchup. Enjoy them just the way they are or elevate the flavor by tossing them in our savory garlic seasoning for an additional $1.

dishes.name: Loaded Carne Asada Fries
dishes.description: Crispy fries with juicy Jalisco-style carne asada, melted cheese, fresh textured guacamole, sour cream, and pico de gallo.

dishes.name: Onion Rings
dishes.description: Thick-cut gourmet onion rings, perfectly fried until golden and crisp, with a side of house ranch.

dishes.name: Carne Asada Tacos
dishes.description: Juicy carne asada tacos served on warm corn tortillas, topped with our bold salsa borracha and fresh textured guacamole. Includes a crisp garden side salad.

dishes.name: Birria Sandwich
dishes.description: Slow-braised birria beef, full of bold spices, stacked on a golden toasted telera roll with melted cheese, cilantro, onion, and guacamole. Served with a side of regular fries.

dishes.name: Chicken Tacos
dishes.description: Grilled chicken served on warm corn tortillas topped with our bold salsa borracha and fresh textured guacamole, served with a crisp garden salad on the side.

dishes.name: Quesa Birria Tacos
dishes.description: Corn tortillas filled with tender, slow-braised beef, melted cheese, and grilled to a golden crisp. Served with a side of rich birria broth for dipping.

dishes.name: Veggie Tacos
dishes.description: Fresh sautéed zucchini, tomatoes, and grilled onions tucked into warm tortillas, topped with our signature salsa borracha and finished with a smooth, textured guacamole, served with a crisp garden salad on the side.

dishes.name: Rolled Tacos
dishes.description: Crunchy hand-rolled corn tortillas, stuffed with tender shredded beef, then fried to perfection. Served with lettuce, sour cream, guacamole and pico de gallo.

dishes.name: Cesar
dishes.description: Romaine lettuce tossed with creamy Cesar dressing, parmesan cheese and crunchy croutons. Grilled chicken available for an additional $8.

dishes.name: Cheesecake
dishes.description: Creamy, rich, and smooth, baked on a buttery graham cracker crust and finished with a hint of vanilla.

dishes.name: Slice Of Pie
dishes.description: A sweet slice of comfort—classic apple pie available daily; additional flavors offered based on availability served with a side of whipped cream.

dishes.name: Whole Pie
dishes.description: Take the flavor home—our pies are available whole to enjoy later!

dishes.name: Cake
dishes.description: Go ahead... you deserve cake! Flavors vary — ask your server.

dishes.name: Soft Drinks
dishes.description: Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Dr. Pepper, Lemonade, Soda Water, Iced Tea.

dishes.name: Mexican Coke
dishes.description: Authentic Mexican Coca-Cola — glass bottle, cane sugar, bold flavor.

dishes.name: Jarritos
dishes.description: Refreshing Jarritos Mexican soda — Mandarin, Pineapple, Tamarind, and Grapefruit.

dishes.name: Hot Tea
dishes.description: English breakfast, Camomille, Earl grey, Premium green.

dishes.name: De Los Altos
dishes.description: A beast of a burger! Beef patties loaded with bacon, pepper jack cheese, lettuce, tomato, grilled onions, jalapeños, avocado, and our house dressing. Comes with a side salad, onion rings and fries to top it off. *No Modifications

dishes.name: Cheese Burger
dishes.description: Juicy beef patty layered with American cheese, crisp lettuce, vine-ripened tomatoes, crunchy pickles, red onions, and our signature house dressing.

dishes.name: Kids Burger
dishes.description: Beef patty with American cheese on soft toasted bun. *12 and under

dishes.name: Chicken Tenders
dishes.description: Crispy breaded and fried strips. Served with our house ranch.

dishes.name: Blue Cheese
dishes.description: Juicy beef patty layered with rich blue cheese crumbles, caramelized onions, smoky bacon and our house dressing.

dishes.name: Western BBQ
dishes.description: A BBQ lover's dream—beef patty loaded with cheddar, bacon, thick-cut gourmet onion rings and tangy BBQ.

dishes.name: Patty Melt
dishes.description: Beef patty, smothered in melted swiss cheese, grilled onions, served between buttery grilled sourdough bread.

dishes.name: Veggie Melt
dishes.description: Vegetarian delight on sourdough, swiss cheese, cucumber, tomato, crispy lettuce, red onion, and fresh sliced avocado.

dishes.name: Deli Sandwich
dishes.description: Your choice sliced turkey or ham layered with avocado, crisp lettuce, vine-ripened tomato, american cheese and mayonnaise on soft white bread.
